_description: FATF-aligned AML/CFT detection rules based on public FATF guidance

rules.name: Structuring Detection
rules.description: Detects transactions just below reporting thresholds (smurfing). FATF Recommendation 20.

rules.name: High Value Transaction
rules.description: Flags transactions above standard monitoring threshold. FATF Recommendation 19.

rules.name: Very High Value Transaction
rules.description: Flags unusually large transactions requiring enhanced due diligence.

bands.reason: Very high value - enhanced due diligence required

rules.name: Round Amount Detection
rules.description: Detects suspiciously round transaction amounts often associated with structuring.

rules.name: Account Drain Detection
rules.description: Detects accounts being emptied - common in account takeover and fraud.

rules.name: Significant Balance Reduction
rules.description: Detects accounts left with less than 10% of their balance after a large payment. A full drain to zero is account-drain-001, so the two rules do not count the same payment twice.

rules.name: Same Party Transfer
rules.description: Detects transfers where sender and receiver are the same entity - potential layering.

rules.name: High Transaction Velocity
rules.description: Detects rapid succession of transactions from same account. FATF rapid movement indicator.

rules.name: Extreme Transaction Velocity
rules.description: Detects unusually high transaction frequency indicating automated/fraudulent activity.

rules.name: High Risk Transaction Type
rules.description: Flags transaction types commonly associated with fraud (CASH_OUT, TRANSFER).

rules.name: Cash Intensive Transaction
rules.description: Flags cash-based transactions requiring enhanced monitoring. FATF Recommendation 22.

rules.name: Micro Transaction Detection
rules.description: Flags very small transactions that may be testing stolen credentials.

rules.name: Pass-Through Payment
rules.description: Detects an account that sends on most of what it received in the last hour. Money in, money out is the core pattern of a money mule account.
rules.expression: velocity_inbound_count >= 1 && amount >= 1000.0 && amount >= velocity_inbound_amount_sum * 0.8 && amount <= velocity_inbound_amount_sum * 1.2

bands.reason: Sends on most of the money received in the last hour

rules.name: Fan-Out to Many Payees
rules.description: Detects an account that paid 5 or more different payees in the last hour. FATF layering indicator.

bands.reason: Paid 5 or more different payees in the last hour

_scoring: Detection mode adds score x weight over the rules that match and alerts at 0.7. Context signals (amount size, transaction type, round amounts) weigh 0.05 to 0.1, so together they stay below 0.4. Behaviour signals (drain, structuring, velocity, pass-through, fan-out) weigh 0.2 to 0.4. One behaviour signal with context does not alert. Two behaviour signals do.
